response.sql:
SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_customers_per_support_rep
FROM (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
) AS rep_customer_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Each employee is treated as a support rep, including reps with no assigned customers; those employees contribute zero to the average.

alternatives.interpretation: Average only across employees who are assigned at least one customer.
alternatives.sql:
SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_customers_per_support_rep
FROM (
  SELECT SupportRepId, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM Customer
  WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY SupportRepId
) AS rep_customer_counts;
